name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: fingerprint
description: Stable hash of project, finding type and object; dedupes proposals (TM-18).

name: run_id
description: Run that created or changed the finding.

name: finding_type
description: Lint or check name, e.g. rls_disabled_in_public.

name: severity
description: critical, high, medium, low or info. Critical requires a confirmed probe (TM-14).

name: object_schema
description: Postgres schema of the affected object. Untrusted identifier, stored as data.

name: object_name
description: Name of the affected table, view, function or bucket. Untrusted identifier, stored as data.

name: probe_http_status
description: HTTP status of the anonymous probe, when one ran.

name: probe_row_count
description: Rows the anonymous probe could see, capped at 1000 (invariant 4).

name: probe_confirmed
description: True only when a probe confirmed live exposure.

name: status
description: open, proposed, fixed, verified_closed, dismissed or reopened.

name: project_ref
description: Supabase project ref. Excluded from published aggregate reports.

name: user_id
description: Postern account ID (UUID). Never an email or a name.

name: connection_id
description: ID of the connection (one connected Supabase project) the event concerns.
